title: Near-Optimal First-Order Regret for Bandits with Feedback Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.40861v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study first-order regret guarantees for adversarial bandits with a fixed, known directed feedback graph. For strongly observable graphs, [ACBDK15] establishes a minimax regret of $\widetilde{\Theta}(\sqrt{\alpha T})$, where $\alpha$ denotes the independence number of the graph and $T$ denotes the horizon. On the other hand, the best existing first-order bound scales as $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{(\kappa+1) L^\star})$ [LLZ20], where $\kappa$ denotes the clique partition number, satisfying $\kappa+1\geq\alpha$, and $L^\star$ denotes the cumulative loss of the best arm, leaving a gap between the graph dependence in worst-case and first-order guarantees. In this paper, we bridge this gap by obtaining an expected regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\alpha L^\star}+\alpha)$. translated_title: 带反馈图的赌博机的近最优一阶遗憾
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有固定且已知有向反馈图的对抗性赌博机问题的一阶遗憾保证。对于强可观测图，[ACBDK15] 建立了极小极大遗憾为 $\widetilde{\Theta}(\sqrt{\alpha T})$ 的结果，其中 $\alpha$ 表示图的独立数，$T$ 表示时间范围。另一方面，现有的最佳一阶上界为 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{(\kappa+1) L^\star})$ [LLZ20]，其中 $\kappa$ 表示团划分数，满足 $\kappa+1\geq\alpha$，$L^\star$ 表示最佳臂的累积损失，这在最坏情况保证与一阶保证的图依赖性之间留下了差距。在本文中，我们通过获得期望遗憾界 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\alpha L^\star}+\alpha)$ 来弥合这一差距。我们的第一个结果是针对自感知图（即每个顶点都有自环）这一特殊情况的一种算法。该算法将 EXP3 [ACBFS02] 的更新与一种相结合
tldr: 本文针对固定已知有向反馈图的对抗性赌博机，提出了期望遗憾界为 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\alpha L^\star}+\alpha)$ 的算法，将一阶遗憾的图依赖性从团划分数改进到独立数，从而弥合了最坏情况遗憾与一阶遗憾之间的差距，达到了近最优的一阶遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: This paper bridges the gap between worst-case and first-order regret guarantees for adversarial bandits with feedback graphs by achieving a near-optimal expected regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\alpha L^\star}+\alpha)$, improving the graph dependence from the clique partition number to the independence number.
